decisions.reason: As a low-cost software complement that broadens connectivity for the modular platform, the MQTT proxy still has option value and is inexpensive to leave available while demand continues across IoT and automation use cases.

The CAN bus interface remains strategically relevant for German industrial and embedded customers, and its fit with the firm's core hardware ecosystem justifies continued support despite some niche-demand uncertainty.

The CO2 sensor module is a narrower hardware option with some cost and component risk, but it still aligns with the firm's sensing portfolio closely enough to keep on the market rather than abandon now.

After several years, the touch panel accessory has had enough time to prove demand, and as a peripheral accessory with weaker strategic importance its remaining option value no longer justifies keeping resources tied up.
